profile.name: 海洋光学光谱仪
profile.description: 这是一类通过 USB 连接的紧凑型光纤光谱仪，可用于采集样品的吸收、发射或反射光谱。设备内部带有板载 EEPROM 存储区，用于保存设备标识、校准系数和其他配置数据，常见于科研与教学中的光谱测量和仪器信息管理。
profile.description_en: This is a compact USB fiber-optic spectrometer used to acquire absorption, emission, or reflection spectra from samples. The instrument includes onboard EEPROM storage for device identity, calibration coefficients, and other configuration data, and is commonly used in laboratory spectroscopy and instrument data management.
